propositions: cancelled ACLI link-delete operations are counted as applied links when they should be counted as failures, creating silent divergence where batch_outcome reports error=None with fabricated links_applied values

the root cause is missing --yes flags on workitem link create and link delete subcommands, which causes acli to prompt for confirmation, read EOF from stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, and exit with 'command cancelled' error

the except CalledProcessError handler in _update_one_dispatch_links increments _links_applied unconditionally with no output, treating all ACLI failures as idempotent 404/409 races and hiding the cancellation from logs

idempotent link removals (concurrent deletes with 404/does-not-exist markers) must still count as applied, requiring marker detection across both stderr and stdout streams per the delete_issue precedent
adding a _links_failed counter and narrowing the idempotent check to genuine marker strings enables the silent-noop canary to detect this class of failure
passing --yes to both link subcommands mirrors the existing workitem delete fix for bug 3256 and eliminates the confirmation prompt that causes the cancellation
